articles.title: U.S. DOJ seeks $61 million in what it calls Iran's crypto-laundered black market oil sales
articles.description: Prosecutors have filed a civil forfeiture complaint against what they call Iran's illegal crypto proceeds that are used to fund its military.

articles.title: Wealthy Chinese, tech talent confront tighter borders as Beijing widens exit controls
articles.description: China's new border-control regulations are designed to keep two of its most valuable assets from leaving the country: money and talent.

articles.title: Oil extends gains following Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia
articles.description: Oil extended gains amid reports of fresh Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia and attacks by Iran on ships in the Gulf.

articles.title: Solana transactions just got more than 3 times bigger, giving an edge over Ethereum
articles.description: Transaction V1 raises Solana’s limit to 4,096 bytes from 1,232, giving developers more room for multi-step trades, company-wallet approvals and privacy proofs.

articles.title: CoinEx to cease operation after 9 years, citing ‘significant’ crypto contraction
articles.description: CoinEx said falling trading volumes and liquidity, along with rising regulatory and compliance costs, had exceeded “reasonable boundaries,” with withdrawals remaining open until Dec. 22.

articles.title: Democrats send counteroffer to Republicans over Clarity Act provisions
articles.description: Democratic Senators were said to be meeting late Monday to discuss the latest proposed draft text.

articles.title: China's August retail sales miss forecast while investment slump deepens, piling pressure on Beijing
articles.description: China's investment slump deepened, retail sales growth slowed further in August while industrial output blew past estimates as Beijing warns of supply-demand imbalance.

articles.title: Weapon shortfalls, 'hundreds' of buildings and aircraft damaged, $33.4 billion spent: the U.S. government tallies costs of the Iran war
articles.description: The department revealed that the Iran war had cost an estimated $33.4 billion as of June 29.

articles.title: Balancer eyes wind-down after restructuring fails to revive revenue
articles.description: Balancer cut costs and shipped new products after restructuring, but Marcus Hardt says v3 failed to replace legacy revenue as November’s $128 million exploit continued to weigh on adoption.

articles.title: Oil and Treasury yields haven’t moved this closely in seven years. That’s bad news for markets
articles.description: Oil and 10-year Treasury yields are moving in near lockstep, with their correlation at its strongest since 2019.

articles.title: U.S. House panel shares crypto tax bill ahead of hearing later this week
articles.description: The House Ways and Means Committee published a crypto tax bill addressing de minimis transactions, staking and other issues for which the industry's clamored for policies.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips to $77,800 as Senate Clarity Act vote nears and oil prices climb
articles.description: Bitcoin pulls back from $79,000 as the Senate prepares to vote on the Clarity Act and oil prices rise.

articles.title: Warren to rip Clarity Act on Senate floor ahead of key preliminary vote
articles.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren will call the latest Clarity Act ethics proposal blessed by Trump a "weak fig leaf."

articles.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump bid to lift block on U.S. Postal Service mail-in ballots rule
articles.description: Justice Brett Kavanaugh said that applying the U.S. Postal Service rule in the 2026 midterm elections "would be arbitrary and capricious."

articles.title: Democrats push back on GOP’s ‘final’ CLARITY offer with counterproposal: Politico
articles.description: Some Democrats remain dissatisfied with the bill’s crypto ethics provisions and will be sending a counterproposal just hours before a key procedural vote.

articles.title: Even if Clarity fails, Wall Street’s crypto push is unlikely to stop
articles.description: The Clarity Act could give banks, brokers and asset managers a clearer rulebook, but financial firms have already moved far enough into digital assets that failure may slow adoption rather than stop it.

articles.title: SEC's Atkins backs Clarity Act but says agency will keep pushing crypto rules without it
articles.description: The SEC chair said crypto issuance, transfer agent modernization and custody will form the backbone of the agency’s regulatory push.

articles.title: Samsung backs Nvidia AI chip rival in $230 million funding round as GPU alternatives boom
articles.description: Dutch startup Euclyd raised the funding in a round co-led by Samsung, Somerset Capital Partners, the Scaleup Europe Fund and Innovation Industries.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5% before reversing as traders await Fed meeting
articles.description: The 10-year U.S. Treasury note yield moved lower after reaching a multiyear high on Monday ahead of this week's Federal Reserve interest rate decision.

articles.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Tech controls expand to employees
articles.description: As the U.S.-China tech rivalry simmers, Beijing is increasing restrictions on how its companies can deploy their tech talent overseas.
